Overview.Name: Srujana Sayana
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Early_Morning (optional): Option 3: Any 1 fruit (apple, guava, orange or papaya)
Meal_1: Option 2: Paneer cubes (80 g) + cucumber slices
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small bowl ~150 g) + curd (small bowl)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + chicken curry (100–120 g) + vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + paneer curry (100 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg curry (2 eggs) + vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + mixed vegetable curry + paneer cubes (80 g)
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg omelette (2 eggs) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + fish curry (100 g) + vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Keep non-vegetarian meals to 3–4 meals per week as per your preference.
Include plenty of vegetables with lunch and dinner.
Before attending social gatherings, eat a fruit or a small bowl of curd to reduce overeating.
When boredom or stress triggers eating, drink water and wait 10 minutes before choosing a snack.
Practice yoga regularly and maintain consistent meal timings even with irregular work hours.
Stay hydrated with at least 2.5–3 litres of water daily.
